title: Basic conversions
description: Create variables with different types and practice widening and narrowing conversions. Show the results before and after each conversion.
hints: Widening doesn't need an operator: double d = entero
A char can be assigned directly to int
solutionExplanation: Widening is automatic and safe. Narrowing requires (type) and can truncate (3.14159→3) or overflow (130→-126). char is assigned to int without casting because it is widening.
expectedOutput:
int 250 → double: 250.0
double 3.14159 → int: 3
int 130 → byte: -126
char 'Z' → int: 90

title: Tip calculator with conversion
description: Ask for the bill total as a String, convert it to double, calculate the tip (15% and 20%), and show the results with two decimals. At the end, convert each total to int (truncated) to show the version without cents.
hints: Use Double.parseDouble() to convert String to double
Use (int) to truncate the decimal part
solutionExplanation: We convert the entered String to double with parseDouble. We use printf(%n.2f) to format to 2 decimals. When truncating each total with (int), the decimal part is lost without rounding.
expectedOutput:
Bill total: 47.50

--- Tip options ---
Original total: $47.50
15%: +$7.12 = $54.62
20%: +$9.50 = $57.00

--- Truncated version (no decimals) ---
Original total: $47
With 15%: $54
With 20%: $57

title: Unit converter with validation
description: Create a temperature converter that receives the input as a String, converts it to double, validates that it is a valid number, and converts between Celsius, Fahrenheit and Kelvin using precise formulas.
hints: Use 9.0/5.0 instead of 9/5 to avoid integer division
Use (int) to truncate, Math.round() to round
solutionExplanation: We use Double.parseDouble() inside try-catch to handle non-numeric inputs without crashing. The for-each processes an array of strings. We use (int) to truncate and printf to format.
expectedOutput:
Converting '37.5'... ✅ OK
  37.5°C = 99.5°F = 310.65K
  Truncated: 37°C, 99°F, 310K

Converting '-10'... ✅ OK
  -10.0°C = 14.0°F = 263.15K
  Truncated: -10°C, 14°F, 263K

Converting 'abc'... ❌ Not a valid number

Converting '100'... ✅ OK
  100.0°C = 212.0°F = 373.15K
  Truncated: 100°C, 212°F, 373K

Successful conversions: 3/4
